title: Movie App
shortDescription: A responsive movie discovery platform for browsing movies and exploring detailed information.
description: A React-based movie discovery application featuring an intuitive browsing experience, detailed movie information, and a responsive interface optimized for desktop and mobile devices.

title: All in One Ecommerce
shortDescription: A modern React storefront featuring dynamic products, detailed product pages, and interactive cart functionality.
description: A responsive e-commerce application built with React.js and Tailwind CSS, featuring REST API integration for product listings and details, Context API for cart state management, and reusable components for a consistent shopping experience.

title: Form Validation Application
shortDescription: An interactive form application with input validation, error handling, and real-time user feedback.
description: A React-powered form application designed to improve data entry through input validation, clear error messages, and responsive feedback. Built using React Hooks and component-based architecture.

title: Todo Application
shortDescription: A lightweight task management application for organizing daily tasks through an interactive interface.
description: A React-based task manager featuring task creation, deletion, and dynamic state updates. Built with React Hooks and reusable components to deliver a simple, responsive task management experience.

title: Yankee Website
shortDescription: A responsive website featuring structured content, polished layouts, and interactive frontend elements.
description: A frontend website developed with HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript, focusing on visual consistency, responsive layouts, and interactive elements to deliver a smooth experience across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.

title: Crypto Website
shortDescription: A cryptocurrency-themed website with a modern interface and responsive content presentation.
description: A cryptocurrency-focused frontend project built with HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript. The interface emphasizes clear information hierarchy, modern styling, and responsive layouts for an accessible browsing experience across devices.

title: Colorlib Website
shortDescription: A website recreation focused on refined styling, responsive layouts, and consistent visual presentation.
description: A frontend implementation project developed with HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript to practice translating design references into structured web layouts. Focused on responsive styling, visual consistency, and interactive interface elements.
